'''Tiny''' was the chief [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Great Geel (post-Vanishing)|''Geeloniran'']], [[Great Geel|leader]] of the [[Geelan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], sometime after the event known as [[the Vanishing]]. Tiny accompanied the ''Geeloniran'' whenever the leader made a trip to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]]. Tiny was a sizable and imposing [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. Others found the bodyguard's name laughable.<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
